task: Read-only explicit native camera-angle QA; no runtime edits, tests, imports, server or commit.
recommendedRuntimeDisposition: Recommend lead holds this set from the exact-eight-degree-approved selectable group until correction or an explicit geometric tolerance is accepted. Preserve all appended source/runtime rows. This report does not change current runtime selectability.
approvalScopeCorrection: Earlier independent review checked coherent identity, silhouette and guide-fitted anchors; it did not prove painted8degree camera. Source/guide naming and eight working runtime IDs do not establish native geometry.

target.formula: shallow=sin(pitch)*tan(yaw), steep=-sin(pitch)/tan(yaw); at30degrees sin(pitch)=0.5. Equivalent yaw from shallow atan(2*abs(slope)); from steep atan(0.5/abs(slope)).

measurementMethod.coordinates: Native1254x1254sheet divided into627x627cells; all ranges/points are cell-local pixels.
measurementMethod.alphaMethod: For each x in inspected unobstructed foundation run, take the lowest y with alpha>threshold. Fit y=m*x+b by unweighted least squares.
measurementMethod.rangeSensitivity: Also repeat after trimming15percent from each end; primary uses alpha>128 and full selected run.
measurementMethod.uncertainty: Numerical regression standard errors measure raster line fit only; neighboring pixels are correlated and do not capture painterly edge choice, shadow/thickness or camera departures. Threshold/subrange ranges are sensitivity diagnostics, not confidence intervals. Illustrative endpoint band allows±2px at EACH endpoint, changing slope by±4/span; this is a systematic-placement scenario, not measured statistical noise.
measurementMethod.edgeSelection: Avoid bench, steps, crate, occluded far edges, roof pitch slopes and eave corners. Foundation outlines can still include painted contact/shadow thickness. Separate eave transition provides independent feature diagnostic.

conclusions: Yaw shallow alpha>128 slopes N0.059884,E0.063168,S0.059724,W0.058116 imply6.83,7.20,6.81,6.63degrees at30down, below target0.0702704/8degrees.

The long S390px foundation run falls4.11px short of target rise; W255px falls3.10px short. Measured line RMS is0.31–0.32px, but systematic painted boundary uncertainty is larger; do not substitute tiny fit errors for physical confidence.
Steep foundation edges N/S/W imply8.17/8.46/8.04degrees at30down. Paired slopes fit a lower effective pitch rather than the exact requested8degree/30degree camera.
Independent eave transition N7.74degrees and S7.81degrees is closer to8, but inconsistent with same-view shallow foundations; source is painterly and nonuniform, not a certified ideal camera.

NormalSE/SW/NW clean sides are broadly near45degrees; normalNE short front-side run gives40.36degrees while its other side gives45.46. Treat this as a further base/trim geometry ambiguity, not clean mathematical normal-camera approval.

House retains coherent realistic1950s identity/daylight, but exact normal+yaw8 camera requirement remains unverified. Regenerate against detailed guides and repeat native straight-edge measurements, or record an explicit lead/owner tolerance before restoring exact-camera approval. No additional implementation is needed for this read-only result.
